Do you watch other magicians, to try to figure out how it's done (and maybe improve on?)

I used to but eventually you reach a point where you pretty much just know what they're doing right away. I still enjoy watching, but now I am really more just appreciative of their performance styles and subtleties.
Thanks for posting! Do you have a favorite trick to perform?

I do! My all time favorite trick to perform is my own version of what's called a 'bill transpo.' Basically, a $1 bill and a 5$ bill are folded up. The spectator holds on to the five in their first. I hold the one in plain view and shake it a little. It visually morphs into the five. The spectator opens their hand and they are now holding the one.

There are 4-5 effects I do that are very very special to me. Most of them are card tricks. But this one has always been my favorite.
That's awesome. One more question: how long did it take you to get confident...the point where you thought "I'm good enough to do this full-time"?

It's easy to think you are good enough when you really aren't. There are just so many aspects to fine tune. Sleight of hand is just the beginning. I think it happens to all of us. But you get knocked down and you climb back up. Realistically, I'd say it took about ten years til I was good enough to make it my full time job.
